doc: The Unfinished Rite — a single-step `veil` reading test: a settlement partway
through a working meant to end its own deaths, two of its makers already dead,
and a second reader on site who has been paid to call the thing sound.
THR-1254 — the corpus's FIRST composed hand. This is the encounter that flips
`repertoire-deals-into-encounter-hand` from PARTIAL to LIVE: step 0 authors two
specials and declares `deal`, so the dealer runs in a real playthrough for the
first time. Everything else the dealt-hand model needs shipped under THR-1247
(engine) and THR-1248 (corpus + authoring surfaces).
── Game design fixed BEFORE the fiction (director ruling, 2026-08-24) ──
Portfolio need first: `veil` is the corpus's thinnest reach (15 of 178 shipped
encounters) and `sacred`/`arcane`/`rural` its thinnest setting classes (3 each),
against `wayside`'s 12 — so this encounter is a veil test written for the three
starving classes, and deliberately not another roadside vignette. Family `delve`
is likewise the thinnest (2). Structure, difficulty, hand shape, cost channels,
persistence and both drawn consequence families were all settled before a
premise existed; the plot hook was rolled afterwards and written to fit them.
Rolled constraints:
plotHookRolled: hook.ritual_of_undeath, hook.betrayal_revealed, hook.trial_by_combat
plotHookTaken:  hook.ritual_of_undeath  (weight 6.00, affinity)
Seed Dice — p3Shape: contest (compounded once with plea, on purpose);
agentRole: the judge asked to rule; scale: settlement.
consequenceDraw (binding, compiler-stamped): place, omen
── The composed hand (THR-1247/1248) ──
Two authored specials plus `deal: { count: 4, tags: ['insight','lore'] }` — a
composed hand of six. Both specials are things the dealer structurally cannot
produce, which is the whole specials rule:
· `rite.loosen_their_nerve` is person-scoped — `opposes: 'rival'` sources the
modifier from THIS scene's bound cast member, so the panel reports the other
reader losing the room rather than a nameless tilt. A generic Stumble knows
no cast key.
· `rite.kindle_heresy` is reach-scoped — `axiological_mark_apply` needs a
`reach`, and only this encounter knows the test is `veil`. This is the exact
case the authoring spec § 3b names as the clearest special.
Neither is a plain odds boost and neither carries a rider: the spec retires both
as specials because every god already holds them in the Repertoire.
No `exclude` list. The scene is a settlement with people in it, so no card type
is nonsense here, and the spec prefers a special over describing a hand by
subtraction.
── Prose Doctrine v2 (narrator mode) ──
Narrator's checklist (12 questions), answered:
1. P1 arrival with {name} and {location}, one per declared class — yes.
2. P2 states the working and the cost already paid (two of the six makers
dead) — yes.
3. P3 lands contest (a rival reader already on site, wanting the same
commission) compounded once with plea (asked to rule) — yes, on purpose.
4. Opening <=80 words with any P1 (65 at the longest) — yes.
5. Every sentence a narrator's report; no interior sensation, no camera — yes.
6. Facts stated, never encoded — the rival's payment is said outright rather
than implied by a purse — yes.
7. Every sentence serves challenge (the rite) / test (veil) / outcome (the
reading that stands) — yes.
8. Nothing referenced before introduction; {cast:keeper} enters in P2, the
rival in P3 — yes.
9. One named person on stage per beat: keeper in P2, rival in P3 — yes.
10. Stake in one sentence: rule truly on a rite that is killing its makers,
against a reader already paid to bless it — yes.
11. Cards named imperative verb+noun; effect lines state game effects; no
effect line repeats a word from its own card name — yes.
12. All three declared classes have a skeleton opening — yes.
── Load-bearing notes ──
`$target` binds to the location for this template family by construction:
`generateUnifiedCandidates` always sets `targetId: locationId` for a
`locationSubtypes`-gated candidate, and this template is gated by the derived
expansion of `settings`. That is what makes the drawn `place` family wireable
at all.
The `place` family carries persistence, not `omen`. `emit_omen` is print-only
(`PERSISTENT_EFFECT_KINDS` excludes it), so the Rewards block rides the
location conditions on step metadata — which fire on the band class
unconditionally rather than behind a reaction click. `successMetadata` fires on
`isStepSuccess`, which counts `near_miss` as a success, so a true reading marks
the place on every success-side band.
No authored `factorLines` (THR-892 variance rule): everything an earlier pass
wanted to list reads identically on every run, so it is priced into difficulty
0.40 (`fair`) and carried by the prose. 0.40 sits under
`NUDGE_OFF_REACH_MAX_DIFFICULTY` (0.45) because this is an open draw and `veil`
is off-reach for most mortals — a `severe` open-draw step is a decorative hand.
Trait hooks (mandatory four questions, § 5): Gate? No — an open-draw rarity-1
encounter gates on nothing. Variant? Yes, `trait.core.core_integrity.virtue` —
a reader whose word matches their reading gives the true one anyway. Trait-only
nudge? No — the specials budget is spent on the two the dealer cannot produce,
and the Repertoire deals trait cards itself. Trait fragment? No.

template.name: The Unfinished Rite

openings.sacred: {name} arrives at the temple of {location} in the late afternoon.
openings.arcane: {name} arrives at the working-house of {location} before dark.
openings.rural: Travelling through the farmland, {name} stops at the village of {location}.

steps.narrativeTemplate:
There {they} find a working half-finished. {cast:keeper} and five others began a rite to end their own deaths, and two of them are already dead.

They have asked {name} to read the working and say whether it will hold. Another reader, {cast:rival}, is already here, and has been paid to say that it will.
steps.successAfterimage: They read the working and gave their answer in front of everyone.
steps.failureAfterimage: They could not follow the working, and the other reader's answer stood.
steps.successAtCostAfterimage: They gave a true answer, and the makers will not speak to them now.
steps.criticalSuccessAfterimage: They read the whole shape of it and named what it would cost, and the makers listened.
steps.criticalFailureAfterimage: They lost their way inside the working, and the makers carried them out of it.

nudges.name: Loosen Their Nerve
nudges.effectLine: Set the other reader second-guessing — their answer comes out hedged, and the room hears it.
nudges.fiction: Every structure has one loose piece.

bandProse.success: The other reader hedged, and the room listened to them instead.
bandProse.near_miss: The other reader lost the room. It bought time, not an answer.
bandProse.failure: The other reader hedged, and it changed nothing — they had no better reading to give.

nudges.name: Kindle Heresy
nudges.effectLine: Fill them with the conviction that the old rule about death was only ever a custom — they will judge as a maker.
nudges.fiction: It works. That is the problem.

bandProse.critical_success: They read it as its makers had, and saw the whole shape of it at once.
bandProse.success: They stopped arguing with the rite and started reading it, and it came open.
bandProse.success_at_cost: They got the reading, and something in them has stopped believing the old rule.
bandProse.failure: They read it as a maker would and still could not follow it.
bandProse.critical_failure: They had talked themselves into the working, and it took them further in than they could find their way back from.

traitVariants.factorLine: Being True, they will say what they read, not what they were asked to read.

narrativeTemplates.initiation: Say the working will hold and it goes on. Say it will not and the makers must stop, or go on without a reader behind them. The other reader has already been paid for one of those answers.
narrativeTemplates.success: {name} read the working and gave their answer where everyone could hear it. What happens to the rite now is the makers' to decide.
narrativeTemplates.failure: {name} could not follow the working far enough to judge it. The other reader's answer is the one that stands, and the rite goes on.

fallback.overview: The working stands where it stood, half-finished.

critical_success.overview: {actor} read the whole working and named what it would take to finish — and what it would cost the six who started it. {cast:keeper} stopped the rite that evening. Word of the reading has left the settlement.

changes.title: The Place Is Watched
changes.causeClause: A true reading was given here in front of everyone
changes.detail: {location} is under watch now — people are coming to see where the rite was stopped.

changes.title: The Telling Spreads
changes.causeClause: The reading was given where everyone could hear it
changes.detail: The story of a rite against death, stopped by a reader, is being carried out of {location}.

reactions.label: Let the reading be told
reactions.intent: The story travels, and the country hears what was attempted here.

effects.narrativeHook: A people tried to put an end to their own deaths, and a reader stopped them before it was finished.

success.overview: {actor} followed the working far enough to say it would not hold, and said so. {cast:rival} did not argue it. {cast:keeper} has not decided what to do with the answer.

changes.title: The Place Is Watched
changes.causeClause: A reader gave an answer here that the makers did not want
changes.detail: {location} is under watch now — the argument about the rite has not ended.

changes.title: The Telling Spreads
changes.causeClause: The reading was given in front of the makers
changes.detail: Word of an unfinished rite against death is travelling out of {location}.

reactions.label: Let the word go with them
reactions.intent: The reading is repeated on the road, and the country starts hearing it.

effects.narrativeHook: There is a settlement where the dead were meant to stop dying, and the working was never finished.

success_at_cost.overview: {actor} gave a true answer and the makers will not speak to them now. {cast:keeper} asked them to leave before dark. The working has not been touched since.

changes.title: The Place Is Watched
changes.causeClause: The reading was given and the reader was sent away for it
changes.detail: {location} is under watch now, and the people there are counting who comes to look.

changes.title: The Keeper Turned
changes.causeClause: They said the working would not hold, and said it out loud
changes.detail: {cast:keeper} does not want them back at {location}.

reactions.label: Let them go before dark
reactions.intent: The reader leaves, and the answer stays behind without them.

failure.overview: {actor} could not follow the working far enough to judge it. {cast:rival} gave the answer the makers had paid for, and the rite goes on tonight.

changes.title: The Place Is Feared
changes.causeClause: The rite went on with nobody able to say what it would do
changes.detail: {location} has a name now, and travellers are going around it.

changes.title: The Telling Spreads
changes.causeClause: A paid reader blessed a working nobody had read
changes.detail: Word is travelling that a rite against death was blessed without being understood.

reactions.label: Let them finish it
reactions.intent: The rite goes on unread, and the country will hear about it either way.

effects.narrativeHook: A working against death was blessed by a reader who had been paid in advance, and it is still running.

critical_failure.overview: {actor} went too far into the working and lost their way in it. {cast:keeper} and two others pulled them out. {cast:rival}'s answer stands unopposed, and the rite is being finished.

changes.title: The Place Is Feared
changes.causeClause: A reader was carried out of the working in front of everyone
changes.detail: {location} is being avoided now, and the people there know it.

changes.title: The Telling Spreads
changes.causeClause: The reader who came to rule had to be carried out
changes.detail: The story leaving {location} is that the working beat the person sent to read it.

reactions.label: Let them be carried out
reactions.intent: The reader is dragged clear, and the story goes out ahead of them.

effects.narrativeHook: A reader went into an unfinished working against death and had to be pulled back out of it.

template.description: A settlement is partway through a rite meant to end its own deaths, two of the six makers are already dead, and a second reader has been paid to call the working sound. Read it and say whether it will hold.
